summary: A 1938 CCC ground house, a 1978-79 three-story tower burned in 2007, and a replacement opened in 2014 that stands on the same site.

facts.design: Replacement tower of stone, concrete and steel with an ADA-accessible ramp and an open circular deck
facts.status_note: The replacement tower opened in 2014; the 1978-79 three-story lookout burned in 2007.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Clinch Ranger District

access.note: Recreation area open late May to late September per the Forest Service; separate tower hours are not listed

visit.trail_note: ADA-accessible ramp (WCYB, 2014); open circular deck (NHLR visit report, 2015)

corrections.why: A replacement tower opened on the same site in 2014 (NHLR; WCYB). Only the 1978-79 three-story lookout burned in 2007.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record notes that NHLR lists lookouts that were standing when registered. The 1997 registration describes the 1978-79 tower, which stood then; the 2014 replacement explains the current status.

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 2007 fire and the 2014 replacement. Unresolved: WCYB (July 2014) says the new tower is a little taller than the old one, while the NHLR visit report (October 2015) says slightly lower. The Forest Service planned completion for 2013; the register gives 2014. The record's kind 'three_story' describes the 1978-79 structure, not the current open-deck tower; consider whether kind should change. The NHLR 2015 visit report marks the tower unstaffed; this is recorded as of 2015 only. Tower hours are not separately listed by the Forest Service. A virginia.org listing seen in search results only was not read in full.
